name: A9 | SOC Copilot - AI tổng hợp alerts

parameters.query: SELECT id, alert_type, severity, ip_address, title, description, status, created_at FROM alerts WHERE status = 'new' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT ip_address, country, threat_type, severity, hits FROM threats WHERE status = 'watching' ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT id, code, title, severity, status, progress FROM investigations WHERE status = 'investigating' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 10

parameters.query: INSERT INTO alerts_summary (time_window, summary, top_threat, affected_targets, recommendation, risk_level, alert_count, threats_count, investigations_count) VALUES ('{{ $json.time_window }}', '{{ $json.summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.top_threat).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb, '{{ JSON.stringify($json.affected_targets).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb, '{{ $json.recommendation.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ $json.risk_level }}', {{ $json.alert_count }}, {{ $json.threats_count }}, {{ $json.investigations_count }}) RETURNING id, created_at
UPDATE alerts SET status = 'processing', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'new' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
